Appraiser remarks
The front bumper cover shows creased deformation and the upper grille bracket is cracked, consistent with a
low-speed frontal contact. However, the damage pattern sits on the rear quarter panel and at a lower height than the
described impact would produce, so the reported mechanism does not fully explain what was found. The repair plan
calls for replacing the bumper cover, the grille bracket and the affected quarter panel, with refinishing and a headlamp
alignment check. The labor hours listed fit the scope of this work. No prior damage to this vehicle is known from our
records. Separately, the shop's ivnoice shows the same service billed twice on one date, and the provider has
acknowledged the second entry was a repeat, so that line should be corrected before payment.
